body:
## Summary
- Replace cached YouTube playlists with the latest YouTube API response during refresh instead of merging stale entries
- Re-render the upload playlist selector after startup refresh resolves so visible UI does not keep stale localStorage markup
- Keep newly created playlists saved additively through the existing create flow
- Apply the related PR #185 late-helper lookup pattern to pipeline playlist refresh/create actions
- Add case-study data and analysis under `docs/case-studies/issue-181`
- Add Cypress coverage for upload and pipeline startup refresh replacing stale cached playlists with API results

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#181

## Reproduction
1. Sign in with YouTube playlist scope so `audio-recorder-youtube-token-state` is restored after restart.
2. Store a stale playlist in `audio-recorder-youtube-playlists`.
3. Restart/open the app while YouTube returns a different current playlist from `playlists.list?mine=true`.
4. Before this fix, rendered playlist selectors could still show stale cached entries. After this fix, a successful refresh replaces the cache and re-renders selectors from the refreshed list.

## Testing
- `npm test -- --runInBand tests/YouTubeUploader.test.ts`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `git diff --check`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/youtube-upload-ui.cy.js` passed the new startup playlist refresh regression; full spec still has 5 unrelated existing settings-sidebar failures where `#presetSettingsBtn` inherits `pointer-events: none`.
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` passed the new pipeline stale-cache regression; full spec still has 2 unrelated existing failures in stage navigator active state and relative publish date update.

## Case Study
See `docs/case-studies/issue-181/analysis.md` and collected raw artifacts in `docs/case-studies/issue-181/logs/`.
